
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/A381532662/p/22391312" title="发布于 2026-08-11 11:29">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">竞品 SERP 周报自动化:每周一早上 9 点自动生成</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>做 SEO 的应该都写过竞品周报——每周手动查竞品排什么词、谁进前五、谁掉了。一次小半天,还容易漏。</p>
<p>这篇文章讲怎么把竞品周报做成全自动:每周一早上 9 点,一份报告自动生成发到群/邮箱。全程不用人管。</p>
<h2 id="整体思路">整体思路</h2>
<p>竞品周报 = 定时抓 → 对比上周 → 生成报告 → 推送。</p>
<p>下面以 SerpBase 的 <code>/google/search</code> 接口为例。</p>
<h2 id="第一步竞品词表">第一步:竞品词表</h2>
<p>先把要监控的词列好。两类:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>竞品品牌词</strong>:竞品名、竞品产品名</li>
<li><strong>行业核心词</strong>:你所在的行业高频词</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-python">KEYWORDS = [
    "竞品A",
    "竞品B",
    "行业词1",
    "行业词2",
]
</code></pre>
<h2 id="第二步定时抓取">第二步:定时抓取</h2>
<pre><code class="language-python">import requests
from datetime import datetime

def fetch_top5(keyword):
    r = requests.post(
        "https://api.serpbase.dev/google/search",
        headers={"X-API-Key": "你的key"},
        json={"q": keyword, "hl": "zh-CN", "gl": "cn"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    organic = r.json().get("organic", [])
    return [
        {"rank": i + 1, "title": x.get("title", "")[:30], "link": x.get("link", "")}
        for i, x in enumerate(organic[:5])
    ]
</code></pre>
<h2 id="第三步存历史对比">第三步:存历史,对比</h2>
<p>每周抓一次,存下来,对比上周:</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import json, os

def load_prev():
    if os.path.exists("prev.json"):
        return json.load(open("prev.json", encoding="utf-8"))
    return {}

def save_curr(data):
    json.dump(data, open("prev.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False)

def build_report():
    prev = load_prev()
    curr = {kw: fetch_top5(kw) for kw in KEYWORDS}
    lines = ["## 竞品 SERP 周报", f"时间: {datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d}", ""]

    for kw in KEYWORDS:
        lines.append(f"### {kw}")
        old = prev.get(kw, [])
        new = curr[kw]
        if old and new:
            # 找出变化
            for item in new:
                rank = item["rank"]
                before = next((p["rank"] for p in old if p["link"] == item["link"]), None)
                mark = ""
                if before and before != rank:
                    mark = f" (从{before}变)"
                lines.append(f"{rank}. {item['title']}{mark}")
        else:
            for item in new:
                lines.append(f"{item['rank']}. {item['title']}")
        lines.append("")

    save_curr(curr)
    return "\n".join(lines)
</code></pre>
<h2 id="第四步推送">第四步:推送</h2>
<p>生成完报告,推送到目标。两种常见:</p>
<p><strong>发邮件</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import smtplib
from email.mime.text import MIMEText

def send_email(body):
    msg = MIMEText(body, "plain", "utf-8")
    msg["Subject"] = "竞品 SERP 周报"
    msg["From"] = "you@example.com"
    msg["To"] = "team@example.com"
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.login("you", "pass")
        s.send_message(msg)
</code></pre>
<p><strong>发群</strong>(飞书/钉钉 webhook):调 webhook 就行,几行代码。</p>
<h2 id="第五步定时跑">第五步:定时跑</h2>
<p>GitHub Actions 每周一早上:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">name: competitor-weekly
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 1 * * 1"   # 周一 1 点 UTC(北京 9 点)
jobs:
  weekly:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      - run: pip install requests
      - run: python weekly.py
        env:
          SERPBASE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.SERPBASE_API_KEY }}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="效果">效果</h2>
<p>以前:每周手动 2-3 小时,容易漏。<br>
现在:周一早上自动生成,看一眼变化就行。</p>
<h2 id="注意">注意</h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>固定 <code>hl</code>/<code>gl</code></strong>:周报对比才有意义</li>
<li><strong>别盯太细</strong>:一天的变化可能是噪声,周维度看趋势</li>
<li><strong>成本</strong>:几十个词一周一次,一个月几美元</li>
</ol>
<p>完整参数和响应字段参考:<a href="https://serpbase.dev/docs" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">serpbase.dev/docs</a>。这套周报,我搭完就没再手动做过。</p>
